quarterly_data.signal: Dycom's 10-K backlog as of January 31, 2026 (dollars in millions): total $9,542.0 million, of which $6,358.0 million is expected in the next 12 months, versus $7,759.9 million ($4,642.5 million next 12 months) as of January 25, 2025; Communications $8,333.5 million ($5,249.6 million next 12 months) and the new Building Systems segment $1,208.5 million ($1,108.4 million). The 10-K says many of its Communications segment customers provide certain fiber-related services for hyperscaler and data center projects, its new Building Systems segment customers focus on data center infrastructure to support AI needs, and it continues to expand its opportunities with hyperscaler and data center customers as a result of the Power Solutions acquisition. Dycom expects fiscal 2027 capital expenditures, net of disposals, of $210.0 million to $220.0 million.
